actor.description: Deprecated legacy actor profile. Shamoon (Disttrack) is wiper malware (MITRE ATT&CK S0140). The term has sometimes been used for operators, but actor identity is modeled separately.
actor.analyst_notes: Use Greenbug / Volatile Kitten for the actor cluster where supported by actor-specific reporting. Do not use the Shamoon software name as an exact actor identity.

capabilities.analyst_notes: Shamoon should be modeled as malware under actor profiles when source scope supports it.

key_judgments.statement: Shamoon is wiper malware; the legacy Shamoon actor profile is deprecated and actor tracking is separated into Greenbug / Volatile Kitten where supported.

uncertainties: Some historical reporting uses Shamoon as a metonym for the operators.
assessment.collection_notes: Removed from the active corpus catalog by actor-census-curation.json.

free_text.executive_summary: Shamoonはwiper malwareとして扱い、旧actor profileはdeprecatedとする。Actor側はGreenbug / Volatile Kittenを別entityとして追跡する。
